sloka: राज्यं यदि हि रामस्य भरतस्यापि तत्तदा ।मन्यते हि यथात्मानं तथा भ्रात्R^ऊंश्च राघवः ॥२-८-१९॥
transliteration: rājyaṁ yadi hi rāmasya bharatasyāpi tattadā ।manyate hi yathātmānaṁ tathā bhrātR^ūṁśca rāghavaḥ ॥2-8-19॥

translations.english: If the kingdom is Rama's, it is also Bharata's, since Rama regards his brothers as his own self
